current_evidence: The 'Information requirements' subpage of the council's planning application requirements index links three checklists (Application Requirements, Householder Requirements, Listed Building Requirements) that combine national and local requirements. Each PDF is headed 'Information Requirements and Validation' and dated 7 January 2013, and no newer list was found.

issues.detail: The workbook links the general 'Planning application requirements' index page of topic links. The validation list itself is on the 'Information requirements' subpage as three PDFs (Application, Householder and Listed Building Requirements). Grokbot visited that subpage but did not open the PDFs.
issues.evidence: Information requirements page links 'Application Requirements (PDF)', 'Householder Requirements (PDF)', 'Listed Building Requirements (PDF)'

issues.detail: The list date is null/'Undated'. The validation PDFs are dated 7 January 2013, so the list is over 10 years old and should be flagged as outdated (>2y).
issues.evidence: 'Information Requirements and Validation: Applications for Planning Permission', 7 January 2013

issues.detail: Householder is recorded as '(none) - national requirements only', but the Householder Requirements PDF sets local requirements: existing and proposed elevations (always, with facing materials and the wall down to ground level), floor plans (always), site sections/finished floor and site levels (unless far from any boundary or the area is unusually flat), a street scene drawing where the dwelling's height is increased, and a Design and Access Statement in conservation areas.

Under Full planning, the local drawing requirements from the Application Requirements PDF are missing: a layout plan (all applications) showing rights of way, trees kept or removed, landscaping, access and parking; elevations and floor plans with specified detail; site sections and levels unless far from boundaries or the area is unusually flat; and a street scene drawing for infill buildings.
Listed building consent is recorded as '(none)', but the council publishes a separate Listed Building Requirements validation checklist. Grokbot did not read it.
issues.evidence: Information requirements page: 'Listed Building Requirements (PDF, 36.92 KB)'

issues.detail: Several requirement topic pages on the index are not captured as rows: Affordable housing, Community Infrastructure Levy, Open space statement, and Sustainable urban drainage design (captured only under Change of use).
issues.evidence: Planning application requirements index: 'Affordable housing', 'Community Infrastructure Levy', 'Open space statement', 'Sustainable urban drainage design'

issues.detail: Most Full planning trigger excerpts are just the index link blurbs ('Find out when a Noise Impact Assessment is required...', 'Find out when a Flood Risk Assessment is required...'). They state no threshold, location or application type.
issues.evidence: trigger_excerpt e.g. 'Air quality requirements Find out when an Air Quality Assessment is required...'

issues.detail: All 13 Full planning rows are 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning'. The Flood Risk Assessment and SuDS rows are placed under Change of use, although the flood risk page sets site-area/flood-zone triggers that apply to all application types. The 'Sequential / Exception Test (flood)' row quotes the town centre uses sequential test, which is a retail test, not a flood test.
issues.evidence: trigger 'Town centre use Find out when a sequential test is required for town centre development proposals'

issues.detail: The only tab_item is a link to the Wind Assessment Guide plus a Rights of Light Act disclaimer, which is not a validation requirement.
issues.evidence: 'Applicants should note that planning permission does not confer any immunity... Rights of Light Act 1959'

summary: Grokbot linked Sheffield's requirements index page instead of the Information requirements checklists (dated 7 January 2013), and left the list undated. It recorded no local requirements for householder or listed building applications although local checklists exist for both, and its Full planning triggers are just link blurbs.
